description: Reference-label meaning and provenance through the Rust core. Each record set loads with the named definition file, then validates every input object and every reference label. One answer or level outside the declared labels of its check rejects the load. One reference whose acceptance meaning disagrees with its stated expected outcome loads, stays as written, and appears as one finding, because one human must decide the conflict. The summary counts keep human judgments apart from model proposals.

metadata.name: Label provenance cases
metadata.sampling_method: Selected from reviewed development work. No prevalence claim.

valid.note: One human-reviewed reference, one agent proposal, and one record without labels. Only the reviewed reference counts as reviewed evidence.
One ambiguous reference keeps its review marker and states one review outcome. It needs one human review before it serves as a reference.
valid.records: {"id": "message-supported-110", "group": "limits", "tags": ["missing-context", "review"], "input": {"prior_decision": "Ship on Friday.", "conversation": "We agreed to ship on Thursday.", "proposed_message": "We now ship on Thursday."}, "expected": {"checks": {"message-supported": {"review": true}}, "outcome": "review"}, "label": {"author_type": "model", "origin": "synthetic", "reviewed": false, "reason": "Agent proposal. No human review yet."}}

valid.note: One accepted answer beside one failing outcome stays as written and is flagged for review. No field of the record changes.
valid.records: {"id": "message-supported-201", "group": "dates", "input": {"prior_decision": "Ship on Friday.", "conversation": "We agreed to ship on Thursday.", "proposed_message": "We now ship on Thursday."}, "expected": {"checks": {"message-supported": {"answer": "supported", "outcome": "fail"}}}, "label": {"author_type": "human", "origin": "collected", "reviewed": true, "reviewer": "Reviewer One", "reason": "The answer follows from the supplied evidence."}}

valid.note: The stated check outcome passes, but the overall outcome fails. The aggregate of the stated outcomes disagrees, so the record is flagged.

valid.note: Ordered levels follow the acceptance meaning of at_least. The consistent record reports nothing; the level below acceptance with one pass outcome conflicts.
